findings.description: The integrity count now counts Git index entries rather than files present on disk. `git ls-files` still lists tracked files deleted from the working tree, so deleting a managed file leaves ACTUAL_COUNT unchanged and the integrity check reports no mismatch.
findings.failure_mode: An incomplete or damaged standard installation passes preflight because the expected manifest count still matches the index count despite missing System Zone files.
findings.suggested_fix: Filter the tracked paths by their existence in MANIFEST_TREE before counting, or explicitly check each manifest path exists while retaining the intended submodule mount handling.

findings.description: A manifest path that is absent from the mount but present under .loa/<path> is now counted as informational 'not-mounted' and never changes the exit code. The only gate is `-d .loa/.claude`, so in any submodule mount a deleted or never-created link for a manifest-covered file (hooks, scripts, rules) that used to be reported as `Missing` (fail) now passes integrity. The check cannot distinguish 'intentionally unlinked subset' from 'required link removed'.
findings.failure_mode: Removing a symlink such as .claude/scripts/preflight.sh or a hook in a submodule-mounted downstream no longer fails check-loa.sh; the System Zone integrity check reports 'Integrity verified' plus a one-line count, masking tampering by deletion.
findings.suggested_fix: Compare against the mount's declared link set (what the mount script actually links) rather than treating every absent-but-upstream path as benign, or at minimum emit the list of not-mounted paths and fail when a path under a required-prefix allowlist (hooks/, scripts/, rules/) is unlinked.

findings.description: `ms(ts)` strips only a `.NNNZ` suffix and then calls `fromdateiso8601`, which accepts only `%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ`. `wall_clock_ms` guards with `$p.started != null`, so an empty string, a `+00:00` offset, or any non-canonical timestamp in meta/pipeline.json raises a jq runtime error. Under `set -euo pipefail` the whole `ROW=$(jq ...)` assignment aborts, the row is never written, and the only output is a jq stack message with no run_id. The same class of hard failure applies to `voices(e)` indexing `.verdict_quality.*` and `.metadata.companion_voice.planned` when those fields are non-object (e.g. a boolean companion_voice).
findings.failure_mode: A batch runner that writes `started` with a timezone offset, or a grader/envelope with a scalar where an object is assumed, loses every row for that run with exit 5 from jq instead of a degraded row or a usage error; downstream runs.jsonl silently has gaps.
findings.suggested_fix: Wrap date parsing in `try (...) catch null` and fall back to the per-phase duration sum when either timestamp fails to parse; guard `voices(e)` field access with `(e.verdict_quality // {} | objects)` style checks; and trap jq failure on the ROW build to print the run_id and exit 2.

findings.cross_file_justification: find_pricing (loa_cheval/metering/pricing.py, exercised by the diff-touched test_pricing_resolution_ladder.py) resolves codex-headless → hop → gpt-6.1-sol and create_ledger_entry stamps pricing_source="config" with no placeholder indicator; ablation-row.sh (in diff) sums those cost_micro_usd values into runs.jsonl cost_usd.
findings.description: The gpt-6.1-sol rate card is an acknowledged placeholder (gpt-5.5 prices copied), yet every codex-headless MODELINV row and every ablation runs.jsonl cost_usd derived from it carries pricing_source="config" with no marker. Once the real card is confirmed, historical ledger and ablation cost figures are silently wrong and indistinguishable from confirmed-price rows.
findings.failure_mode: Ablation batches run between 2026-10-15 and the rate-card confirmation record cost_usd computed from the wrong rate card; spend.sh budgets and cost-per-arm comparisons are off by the price ratio with nothing in the data flagging it.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a `pricing_confirmed: false` (or `placeholder: true`) key under the pricing block, have create_ledger_entry propagate it as `pricing_placeholder: true` on the ledger row, and have ablation-row.sh surface it in degraded_reason so rows can be re-priced later.

findings.description: The header promises that a missing tool 'changes the fingerprint instead of failing the run', but the digest is computed with `python3 -I -c ...` after `tool_version python3` may have printed `python3=absent`. With `set -euo pipefail` the script exits non-zero on hosts without python3, so pipeline-run.sh / MANIFEST.json generation fails rather than recording an `absent` entry. Separately, the bats fallback is a hard-coded operator home path (`~/.local/dotfiles/tools/diff-so-fancy/test/bats/bin/bats`), which reads `absent` on any other host and makes the fingerprint host-specific for reasons unrelated to the toolchain.
findings.failure_mode: On a container or CI host without python3, every ablation run aborts at fingerprinting; on hosts other than the original operator's, fingerprints differ solely because of the private bats path, defeating cross-host comparability.
findings.suggested_fix: Fall back to `sha256sum`/`shasum -a 256` when python3 is absent (still no sourcing of .claude/ code), and drop the operator-specific bats path in favour of `LOA_EVAL_BATS_BIN` + PATH lookup only.

findings.cross_file_justification: check_integrity (in diff) hashes every path in .claude/checksums.json against the working tree; this diff modifies several System Zone files that such a manifest normally covers (model-config.yaml, generated-model-maps.sh, check-loa.sh, preflight.sh, bridgebuilder dist/resources) but the changed-file list does not include .claude/checksums.json.
findings.description: Multiple manifest-covered .claude/ files change in this diff while .claude/checksums.json is not among the changed files (only model-config.yaml.checksum is). If the manifest is committed rather than regenerated at release, check-loa.sh will report `Tampered:` for each of these paths on the next mount, and preflight's count check may also drift. This could not be verified from the provided diff (tools/gen-checksums.sh changed but was truncated).
findings.failure_mode: Fresh mounts of this commit fail System Zone integrity with Tampered on model-config.yaml, generated-model-maps.sh, check-loa.sh and preflight.sh until the manifest is regenerated.
findings.suggested_fix: Regenerate .claude/checksums.json with tools/gen-checksums.sh in the same change, or confirm in the PR that the manifest is produced at release time and add a CI step that fails when tracked .claude/ files differ from the committed manifest.
